project.name: Project Assurance Modules
project.phase: v0.2 bounded extraction: generic structured handoff contract

components.name: Research Assurance structured handoff reference
components.role: reference implementation only; no automatic migration

not_run: PAM generic handoff schema positive and negative tests

next_action.action: Add positive and fail-closed tests for the generic handoff schema and validator.
next_action.acceptance: The example validates, invalid schema versions and identities fail, live-state precedence cannot be disabled, hidden evaluation cannot be exposed, and unknown assurance fields fail closed.

do_not_start: Replace Research Assurance ra-handoff/1.0.0 before explicit parity and migration approval
Treat a handoff packet as live execution truth without reconciliation
Place hidden confirmatory evaluation content in agent-visible handoffs

decisions_not_to_reverse: Live repository and CI state supersede stale handoff observations.
Current resumable state and historical checkpoints are distinct state kinds.
Research Assurance keeps its local handoff contract until generic PAM parity is explicitly proven.

checks: Re-fetch the active branch or pull request head before mutation.
Re-fetch referenced CI or validation state when it can change the next action.
Reconcile component identities that are named as current rather than historical.

hidden_evaluation.policy: Hidden or confirmatory labels, answers, seeds, and reports are excluded from agent-visible handoff state; record only the existence and process boundary when applicable.
